title: Embedding quality canary + batch evaluation orchestrator for rerank endpoint
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Build an orchestrated evaluation system that runs nightly and on-demand batch evaluations plus lightweight canary checks for embedding and rerank endpoints. The system will: 1) maintain per-workload golden sets with stratified sampling (customer + vertical + input length); 2) compute a battery of offline accuracy metrics (cosine recall@k, mean reciprocal rank, normalized discounted cumulative gain, embedding dispersion and centroid shifts); 3) run throughput/latency regressions for combined embed+rerank flows (including tail latency p95/p99); 4) surface drift signals to telemetry and create automated alerts with thresholds and escalation; 5) integrate canary gating into rollout pipelines to block model promotions when quality or latency regressions cross configured limits.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly batch run completes end-to-end for 10 representative workloads and stores metric snapshots in metrics-bucket for 30 days
Canary pipeline executes a lightweight 500-query probe against candidate model and baseline, computes delta metrics, and returns PASS/FAIL within 5 minutes
Dashboard in Console shows time-series for each metric with baseline vs candidate comparison and a heatmap for per-segment drift
Alert rules created: embedding-cosine-drift-high (high), rerank-latency-tail-regression (medium), and embedding-coverage-drop (medium), wired to Slack #embeddings and PagerDuty SRE rotation
Automated rollback hook callable by rollout system and documented in runbook with clear rollback thresholds and owner contacts
tasks: Design metadata schema for golden sets (customer, vertical, purpose, sample seed, validation labels)
Implement batch runner that pulls datasets from gs://embed-evals and runs similarity + rerank evaluations in Kubernetes job
Add batch-level metric computation: recall@K, MRR, nDCG, centroid-shift, dispersion, cosine-distribution-ks-test
Create lightweight canary probe lambda that runs 500 canonical queries and reports delta to telemetry API
Wire alerts into Alertmanager and create PagerDuty escalation policy
Build Console pages: workload selector, time-series comparator, per-segment drift heatmap, and per-deployment scorecard
Add synthetic perturbation generator for adversarial checks (typos, paraphrases, stopword removal, length truncation)
Integrate canary decision with rollout: block promotions if quality delta > configured thresholds or latency tail p99 increases > X%
Load-test runner for batch throughput and GPU memory profiling to estimate nightly run cost and runtime SLOs
Create onboarding docs and gating checklist for Product/Research sign-off before enabling automatic rollbacks
